item.title: Denmark says ‘fundamental disagreement’ over Greenland remains after meeting with Vance, Rubio
item.description: Denmark and Greenland remain firmly opposed to President Trump’s push to bring Greenland under U.S. control, despite what Danish officials described as direct but respectful talks with senior members of the Trump administration at the White House.
